tools.burn: Average the last 3 months of spending

runway.prompt: How long will our cash last?
runway.thoughts: Cash on hand is the operating account plus the reserve. Spending varies month to month, so I'll average the net burn over the last three months rather than use October alone.
runway.answer: About 40 months. You have $1,662,800 across the operating account and the reserve, and the net burn has averaged $41,200 a month over the last quarter. Burn is down 6.8% on last month, mostly because the ad campaigns ended early. If payroll grows as planned in January, runway drops to about 34 months.

tickets.thoughts: Late means past the response time the customer's plan promises. I'll look for open tickets flagged as breached and sort them by priority.
tickets.answer: Three tickets are past the promised time. Lucas Silva (Rio Freight) was charged twice and nobody has the ticket yet: that's urgent, and I'd take it first. Grace Lee (Pinecone Health) can't sign in with SSO, and Olivia Martin (Northwind) can't export invoices. Want me to assign the billing one to Maya?

reminders.thoughts: I'll find invoices past their due date that haven't been paid, then prepare one friendly reminder per customer. Sending emails needs your OK first.
reminders.answer: Three invoices are overdue, $1,240 in total. I've drafted a short, friendly reminder for each customer with a link to pay. Nothing is sent until you approve.

general.thoughts: This demo answers from sample data, so I'll point to what I can look at.
general.answer: In this demo I answer from the sample data. Try asking how long the cash will last, which tickets are late, or to send reminders for overdue invoices. Connect your own model and I can answer anything about your workspace.

approval.title: Send 3 payment reminders
approval.description: Emails each customer whose invoice is overdue, with a link to pay.
approval.approved: Sent. I'll tell you when they're paid.
